scientific_integrity: The finite verifier is corroborative; the unrestricted integer lower bound and the asymptotic envelope are proved analytically. Mathematical novelty has been checked against selected literature but remains subject to independent priority assessment.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three levels with positive inverse temperature and strictly positive logarithmic slope mismatch; canonical golden-ratio gap; first globally unitary-activating identical-copy count only. Not a formula for extracted work, restricted controls, catalysts, or other spectra. The general occupancy criterion is a specialization of existing passivity principles rather than a new general passivity theorem.
title: Fibonacci staircase for finite-copy activation of a passive qutrit with a golden-ratio gap
